# cadesplugin_api.js

The page side of the CryptoPro CAdES browser plug-in («КриптоПро ЭЦП Browser plug-in»): it finds the plug-in's
browser extension and gives `window.cadesplugin` to sign with a qualified certificate (КЭП) in «Подпись»
(`js/qes.js`, GO24DEV-913). As published by CryptoPro: https://www.cryptopro.ru/sites/default/files/products/cades/cadesplugin_api.js
(taken 2026-10-28), unchanged; CryptoPro distributes it for the sites using the plug-in.
